slot.brief: Given position vectors of points, check collinearity or find a unit vector along a line/median; direct computation from formulas.

stem: The position vectors of two points A and B are a = 2i + 3j - 4k and b = 4i + 6j + p k. If a and b are collinear, then the value of p is

verdicts.working: For collinear vectors, b = λa. Comparing the i-components gives λ = 2; hence p = 2(-4) = -8.

working:
Collinear vectors satisfy b = lambda a. Comparing i and j coefficients: 4 = 2 lambda and 6 = 3 lambda, so lambda = 2. Then p = lambda(-4) = -8.

Independent check: For collinear vectors, b = λa. Comparing the i-components gives λ = 2; hence p = 2(-4) = -8.
solution:
For collinear vectors, $b=lambdaa$. Comparing the $i$-components gives $4=2lambda$, so $lambda=2$.
Thus $p=2(-4)=-8$.
